WITH customer_country_spend AS (

WITH RECURSIVE emp_hierarchy AS (

    last_name,

    0 AS level

  WHERE
    reports_to IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.first_name,
    e.last_name,
    e.reports_to,
    eh.level + 1
  FROM chinook.employee AS e
  JOIN emp_hierarchy AS eh
    ON e.reports_to = eh.employee_id
)
SELECT

  level
FROM emp_hierarchy
ORDER BY
  level,
  employee
LIMIT 100

SELECT

  ON t.track_id = il.track_id

  ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id
GROUP BY
  c.customer_id,
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT g.genre_id) >= 10
ORDER BY
  distinct_genres DESC,

SELECT
  o.order_date AS day,
  SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
FROM ecommerce.orders AS o
JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS i
  ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_date >= CAST('2022-06-01' AS DATE)
  AND o.order_date < CAST('2022-07-01' AS DATE)
  AND o.status NOT LIKE 'Cancelled%'
GROUP BY
  o.order_date
ORDER BY
  o.order_date
LIMIT 100

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date) AS month,
    SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
  FROM ecommerce.orders AS o
  JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS i
    ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status NOT LIKE 'Cancelled%'
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  month,
  revenue,
  LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue,
  ROUND(
    (
      (
        revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)
      ) * 100.0
    ) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0),
    2
  ) AS growth_pct
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 100

WITH state_cat_rev AS (
  SELECT
    o.ship_state,
    p.category,
    SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
  FROM ecommerce.orders AS o
  JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS i
    ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecommerce.products AS p
    ON p.sku = i.sku
  WHERE
    o.status NOT LIKE 'Cancelled%'
  GROUP BY
    o.ship_state,
    p.category
), top_states AS (
  SELECT
    ship_state,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_rev
  FROM state_cat_rev
  GROUP BY
    ship_state
  ORDER BY
    total_rev DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 10
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    scr.ship_state,
    scr.category,
    scr.revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scr.ship_state ORDER BY scr.revenue DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
  FROM state_cat_rev AS scr
  JOIN top_states AS ts
    ON ts.ship_state = scr.ship_state
)
SELECT
  ship_state,
  category,
  revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE
  rn = 1
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

WITH sku_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    i.sku,
    SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
  FROM ecommerce.orders AS o
  JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS i
    ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status NOT LIKE 'Cancelled%' AND i.amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    i.sku
), total_rev AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(revenue) AS total
  FROM sku_revenue
), top10 AS (
  SELECT
    revenue
  FROM sku_revenue
  ORDER BY
    revenue DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(t.revenue) / MAX(tr.total), 2) AS share_pct
FROM top10 AS t
CROSS JOIN total_rev AS tr
LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM o.order_date) AS dow,
  SUM(i.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_date) AS avg_daily_revenue
FROM ecommerce.orders AS o
JOIN ecommerce.order_items AS i
  ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE
  o.status NOT LIKE 'Cancelled%'
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  avg_daily_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT

WITH team_wins AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.winner AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM ipl.matches AS m
  WHERE
    m.winner IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    m.season,
    m.winner
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    team,
    wins,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY wins DESC) AS rnk
  FROM team_wins
)
SELECT
  season,
  team,
  wins
FROM ranked
WHERE
  rnk = 1
ORDER BY
  season,
  team
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  d.bowler,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    d.extras_type IS NULL OR NOT d.extras_type IN ('wides', 'noballs')) AS legal_balls,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.extras_type IN ('byes', 'legbyes') THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END
    ) * 6.0 / NULLIF(
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        d.extras_type IS NULL OR NOT d.extras_type IN ('wides', 'noballs')),
      0
    ),
    2
  ) AS economy
FROM ipl.deliveries AS d
JOIN ipl.matches AS m
  ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE
  d.phase = 'death' AND d.inning <= 2 AND m.season >= 2018
GROUP BY
  d.bowler
HAVING
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    d.extras_type IS NULL OR NOT d.extras_type IN ('wides', 'noballs')) >= 300
ORDER BY
  economy ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH team_scorers AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    batter,
    SUM(runs) AS total_runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY SUM(runs) DESC) AS rn
  FROM ipl.batting_innings
  WHERE
    season = 2023
  GROUP BY
    team,
    batter
)
SELECT
  team,
  batter,
  total_runs
FROM team_scorers
WHERE
  rn <= 3
ORDER BY
  team,
  total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1000

WITH first_innings AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    d.batting_team,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS innings_total
  FROM ipl.deliveries AS d
  JOIN ipl.matches AS m
    ON d.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE
    d.inning = 1
  GROUP BY
    m.season,
    d.batting_team
), season_avg AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(innings_total) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_first_innings
  FROM first_innings
  GROUP BY
    season
)
SELECT
  s1.season,
  s1.avg_first_innings,
  ROUND(s1.avg_first_innings - s0.avg_first_innings, 2) AS change_from_prev
FROM season_avg AS s1
LEFT JOIN season_avg AS s0
  ON s0.season = s1.season - 1
ORDER BY
  s1.season
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  bi.batter,
  SUM(bi.runs) AS total_runs
FROM ipl.batting_innings AS bi
JOIN ipl.matches AS m

    c.state,
    p.category_english
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    category_english,
    gmv,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rn
  FROM gmv_by_state_cat

  gmv
FROM ranked

  rn <= 3

  state,

    COUNT(*) AS rounds

    funding_date IS NOT NULL

    COUNT(*) AS rounds
  FROM startups.funding_rounds
